CIVIL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION

 IA No. 144920 OF 2021

 TRANSFER PETITION (CIVIL) NO.23 OF 2020

 CHETNA RATHEE Petitioner(s)

 VERSUS

 CHAHIT KUNDU & ANR. Respondent(s)

 O R D E R
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that an

 application has been filed seeking permission to withdraw this

 Transfer Petition.
Her submission is also placed on record.
Transfer Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Consequently, IA No. 144920/2021 is disposed.
.................................J.
 [B.V. NAGARATHNA]

 NEW DELHI;
November 29, 2021

Reason:
